title: Best Startup Alternatives to LinkedIn Recruiter
summary: Compare LinkedIn Recruiter alternatives for startups: sourcing tools, ATS platforms, and recruiting help, with public pricing and honest tradeoffs.
body_markdown:
LinkedIn Recruiter is a search tool for LinkedIn’s member network, and for a startup that is only one part of hiring. You still need somewhere to track applicants, a way to reach people outside LinkedIn, and someone with the time to run the search. That is why a[LinkedIn Recruiter alternative](https://www.dover.com/) can mean three different things: a sourcing tool that finds candidates, an applicant tracking system (ATS) that organizes them, or a recruiter who does the work. This guide compares six options by what each one replaces, what it costs on its public pricing page, and where it falls short.


**TLDR:**


- Sourcing tools like SeekOut and hireEZ replace LinkedIn’s candidate search. An ATS like Dover or Ashby does not replace LinkedIn’s search, but it handles the tracking that LinkedIn Recruiter leaves to you.
- Free plans differ a lot: Wellfound’s free tier caps contact reveals, while Dover’s free ATS has unlimited jobs, users, and candidates.
- SmartRecruiters and hireEZ are built for larger teams and sell through sales conversations, so budgeting means asking for a quote.
- None of these tools gives you LinkedIn’s member network. If your target candidates only live on LinkedIn, plan to keep some LinkedIn access.
- Software and recruiting help are separate costs. Budget for each one on its own.


## What LinkedIn Recruiter Covers, and What It Leaves to You


LinkedIn Recruiter gives you search filters across LinkedIn’s member network, InMail messaging, and shared project folders for a recruiting team. It does not track applicants through interviews, collect feedback, schedule interviews, or post your jobs to other boards. LinkedIn does not publish pricing for its full Recruiter plans, so the cost comes from a sales conversation. Our[LinkedIn Recruiter cost and review](https://www.dover.com/blog/linkedin-recruiter-alternatives-startups) and[Lite vs Professional](https://www.dover.com/blog/linkedin-recruiter-lite-vs-professional) guides go deeper on what each plan includes.


That split is the useful way to look at alternatives. Ask which job you need replaced: finding people, tracking people, or doing the recruiting.

## Dover: Best Overall for Founder-Led Hiring


We publish this guide, so our pick comes with a bias. Dover fits startups that want to run hiring themselves but need more than an inbox, and it is the only option here that pairs an ATS with optional recruiter help.


- **What it replaces:** the tracking, scheduling links, and outreach work around LinkedIn. The free plan includes a CRM, a free Chrome extension for sourcing candidates from LinkedIn, email outreach campaigns, and posting to 50+ job boards, with unlimited jobs, users, and candidates.
- **What costs extra:** Premium is $199/month with no contract and adds AI resume review, an interview notetaker, bulk actions, and outreach to multiple candidates at once. Fractional recruiters are a separate purchase, and each sets their own rate.
- **Where it falls short:** Dover does not give you a candidate database like LinkedIn’s or SeekOut’s. Sourcing means searching LinkedIn and other sites through the extension, then keeping the people you find in Dover.


## Wellfound: Startup Reach With Capped Free Sourcing


[Wellfound](https://www.dover.com/blog/dover-vs-wellfound) is a job and talent network built around startups, which makes it the closest match to LinkedIn’s inbound-plus-search model at startup scale. Its[pricing page](https://wellfound.com/recruit/pricing) lists free, unlimited job listings with built-in applicant tracking, plus Reach, an AI-assisted candidate search with email outreach through Gmail or Outlook.


- **Pricing:** job posting is free. Reach contact reveals are capped by plan, including the free tier (20 per month at the time of writing), and paid Reach plans start at $135 per seat per month.
- **Also offered:** Autopilot, a done-for-you recruiter service, listed at $500 per open role each month plus a 10% placement fee on a successful hire.
- **Where it falls short:** the candidate pool is Wellfound’s own network, so it suits startup and tech roles better than broad searches, and ongoing sourcing means paying for seats.


## SeekOut: Deep Search, Separate From Your ATS


SeekOut is the most direct substitute for LinkedIn Recruiter’s search. It offers power filters over a large candidate index, including technical and diversity search, plus contact lookup and outreach campaigns. Our[SeekOut vs Dover](https://www.dover.com/compare/dover-vs-seekout) page covers the details.


- **Pricing:** Recruit Core is $179/month for three seats, or $149/month if you pay a year up front. Everything above Core is custom-priced and billed annually.
- **Limits:** Core includes 500 contact credits and 1,000 exports a month. Higher tiers raise those caps.
- **Where it falls short:** SeekOut is a sourcing tool, not an ATS. You still need somewhere to track candidates after you find them.


## hireEZ: Outbound Sourcing for Teams With a Hiring Stack


hireEZ is an outbound recruiting platform for finding candidates beyond your existing applicant pool, and it connects with ATS and candidate relationship tools you already use. Juicebox’s[hireEZ pricing review](https://juicebox.ai/blog/hireez-pricing) notes that team pricing is by custom quote and varies with seat count, credits, integrations, and contract terms.


- **Best for:** teams that already have an ATS and need a larger sourcing pool.
- **Where it falls short:** without a published price, you cannot compare it with other tools until you talk to sales, so request a written quote that lists every capability you need.


## SmartRecruiters: Enterprise ATS, Priced Accordingly


[SmartRecruiters](https://www.dover.com/compare/dover-vs-smartrecruiters) combines an ATS and candidate relationship management for high-volume and distributed hiring, and its AI matching features are gated by plan tier.


- **Pricing:** the Essential plan starts at $14,995 per year, the only price the company publishes. Professional, High Volume, and Complete are quote-only, and there is no free plan or self-serve signup.
- **Where it falls short:** it is built for corporate hiring in retail, hospitality, and healthcare more than for a team filling a few roles. SAP completed its acquisition of SmartRecruiters in September 2025, so expect its roadmap and licensing to follow SAP’s.


## Ashby: Analytics-Heavy ATS for Paid Budgets


[Ashby](https://www.dover.com/compare/dover-vs-ashby) is an all-in-one ATS with scheduling, sourcing, and a custom reporting builder, which suits teams with someone who owns recruiting operations.


- **Pricing:** plans start at about $300/month for small teams and rise with headcount, whether or not you are actively hiring. There is no free plan. Advanced Scheduling and the AI notetaker are sold as add-ons.
- **Where it falls short:** more permission levels, approval steps, and setup than a founder hiring a few roles usually needs.


## Which Alternative Fits Which Job


- **You need a bigger candidate search than LinkedIn gives you:** SeekOut or hireEZ, alongside an ATS.
- **You hire startup and tech roles and want inbound plus search:** Wellfound.
- **You need an ATS first, at no cost:** Dover. If you can pay for analytics and permissions, compare Ashby.
- **You are hiring across many locations or teams:** SmartRecruiters.
- **You do not have time to run the search:** add a fractional recruiter to whichever ATS you use. Dover’s marketplace has them, and they can also work inside Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, or a spreadsheet.


## When LinkedIn Recruiter Is Still the Right Call


No tool on this list matches LinkedIn’s member network. If your target candidates are senior, specialized, and mostly reachable only through LinkedIn, a paid LinkedIn seat may still earn its cost, and an ATS plus a recruiter can sit on top of it. Test any replacement before you cancel: run the same search for your target role, seniority, and location in both tools, then compare how many relevant candidates you can see, contact, and track.


## Software and Recruiting Service Costs


Software subscriptions and recruiting help are separate purchases. On Dover, the ATS is free, Premium is $199/month, and recruiters set their own rates and bill for the work done, with every marketplace hire’s all-in cost listed in the public cost-per-hire table on[Dover’s recruiters page](https://www.dover.com/recruiters#cost-per-hire) . See[Dover’s pricing](https://www.dover.com/pricing) for what each plan includes.


## FAQs


### What is the best free alternative to LinkedIn Recruiter?


It depends on the job. For tracking applicants and managing candidates, Dover’s free ATS has no cap on jobs, users, or candidates. For candidate search, Wellfound’s free tier includes limited monthly contact reveals, so heavier sourcing needs a paid plan or a different tool.


### Can an ATS replace LinkedIn Recruiter?


Not by itself. An ATS tracks applicants, interviews, and offers, but it does not give you a searchable database of passive candidates. Pair an ATS with a sourcing tool or a free LinkedIn-based workflow, such as a Chrome extension that saves profiles into your ATS.


### Do you need a recruiter if you already use an ATS?


An ATS does not find candidates, run outreach, or close offers. Many early-stage teams manage with software alone while hiring a few straightforward roles. A recruiter becomes worth considering when sourcing stalls, a role is specialized, or no one has time to run the search. Fractional recruiters can work in the same ATS as your hiring team, so both sides see one pipeline.


### How can you check whether a replacement reaches the candidates you need?


Run a sample search for your target role, seniority, and location in the new tool and in LinkedIn. Compare how many relevant candidates appear, how many you can contact, and what each tool limits per month. A replacement is a better fit when it reaches the talent you need within your budget, even if its database differs from LinkedIn’s.


### How should you estimate the total cost of a recruiting setup?


List software fees, sourcing allowances, paid upgrades, and any recruiting services separately. Then compare costs for your expected users and hiring volume, including the work your team will still handle. Quote-only tools need a written quote before you can compare them with published prices.


## Final Thoughts on Hiring Beyond LinkedIn Recruiter


The right[LinkedIn Recruiter alternative](https://www.dover.com/) depends on which job you need replaced, not on which tool has the longest feature list. Sourcing tools widen your search, an ATS keeps the pipeline organized, and a recruiter adds capacity when a search outgrows what your team can run. Dover’s model is one example of keeping those separate: a free ATS you can use on its own, with on-demand fractional recruiters who work in the same system when you want them.
